denominator_policy: Each lifecycle state reports only its own named denominator; cross-state ratios require a separately evidenced common basis.
money_policy: Retain source currency and accounting basis; do not sum currencies or incompatible bases without a separately frozen conversion rule.
date_policy: Keep event, publication and retrieval dates separate; retain date precision and do not infer an event date from a register timestamp.

lifecycle_definitions.pledge: A publicly reported political or financial commitment, retained with its stated perimeter and without treating it as an operation.
lifecycle_definitions.allocation: A source identifies an amount reserved, programmed or offered under its own stated allocation terminology.
lifecycle_definitions.approval: A source explicitly records a financing approval or board-equivalent decision; a signature, payment or priority list alone is insufficient.
lifecycle_definitions.signature: A source explicitly records a signed financing agreement or contract.
lifecycle_definitions.disbursement: A source explicitly reports a paid amount or transaction, preserving whether it is a flow or cumulative position.
lifecycle_definitions.implementation: A separately evidenced reported implementation status, not proof of physical delivery or an inferred earlier financial transition.

source_census_handoff.window_rule: 0817 must freeze source-country-period inventories and observation windows before retrieval.
